brazil-first-phase-2021.notes: Source 1 mixes first phase and the Latin American final (April 2022) on one page; its problem PDFs in the crawl (icpcla.pdf, source 6) are of the April 2022 final session (13 problems A-M), not the 30 Oct 2021 first-phase set.

sources.evidence: Page titled 'XXVI Maratona de Programação - 2021' on the Brazilian Marathon's site, reporting the 30 October 2021 first phase and linking problem PDFs and results.
BOCA 'Staff's Page' score table with columns User/Site, Name, A to N and Total, and 513 ranked Brazilian teams with tries and times.
Organisers' 'Primeira Fase' page with the jury, authors, problem and report links, and tables of qualified teams by site, not an ordered ranking.
26-page PDF 'Maratona de Programação da SBC 2021 Sub-Regional Brasil do ICPC', 30 October 2021, stating 14 problems, Problema A to N.
Codeforces gym dashboard '2021-2022 ACM-ICPC Brazil Subregional Programming Contest' listing 14 problems A to N.
